title: Maximize Happiness of Selected Children
description: There are children with happiness values in `happiness`. Choose exactly `k` children one at a time. Before the `i`th choice, every unchosen child's happiness has decreased by `i - 1`, but not below zero. Return the largest total happiness achievable. Input: `happiness`, `k`. Output: the maximum total.
hints: Sort or count values once, then process each candidate in a single pass.
Check duplicates, all-equal inputs, and boundary values for `k`.
